name: Boeing
description: Boeing builds commercial jetliners (Commercial Airplanes), military aircraft, weapons and space systems for governments (Defense, Space & Security), and sells spare parts, maintenance, modifications and aviation services (Global Services). Revenue recognition is per aircraft delivered and per contract milestone, so 2025 revenue rose 34% to $89.5 billion largely on higher commercial deliveries after 2024's strike and production limits. Commercial Airplanes and Defense were still loss-making in 2025 (segment losses of $7.1 billion and $0.1 billion); the company's 2025 segment profit came from a one-off gain on selling part of its Digital Aviation Solutions business for $10.55 billion, booked in Global Services. Total backlog at year-end was $682.2 billion.

employees.note: Total workforce approximately 182,000, 14% outside the US; about 72,000 (40%) union represented.

businessLines.name: Commercial Airplanes (BCA)
businessLines.how: Sells new jetliners to airlines and lessors, recognised when each aircraft is delivered, so revenue follows delivery count and production-rate limits; 2025 loss reflects reach-forward losses on the 777X and 767 programs.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 loss from operations (2024: loss of $7,969M)

businessLines.name: Defense, Space & Security (BDS)
businessLines.how: Government contracts for military aircraft, weapons, space systems and satellites, mostly fixed-price or cost-plus development and production programs; results swing on cumulative contract catch-up adjustments and cost overruns.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 loss from operations (2024: loss of $5,413M)

businessLines.name: Global Services (BGS)
businessLines.how: Sells spare parts, maintenance, upgrades, training and data services to airlines and militaries on installed aircraft (recurring aftermarket), plus the digital aviation business partly divested on 2025-10-31.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 earnings from operations (2024: $3,618M); includes the gain on the Digital Aviation Solutions divestiture

brands.name: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings, Inc.
brands.note: Acquired 2025-12-08 by exchanging about $4.7 billion of Boeing shares; brings fuselages for 737, P-8 and KC-46 and major structures for 767, 777 and 787, plus defense and aftermarket operations and parts of Belfast.

whatsNext.text: Mandatory convertible preferred stock converts automatically into between 5.8280 and 6.9940 common shares per preferred share
